items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: So that's when I joined Benny on a steady basis, you know.

ctx.x: You should see me. I played one set at the club and I had to be at the theater before 10:00 to be ready for -- to go on stage with Benny. So my trio, my quartet, the other kids took over while I was gone and I did the show with Benny and then I had to rush back to my gig at the Three Deuces. So that is actually the first time I have had a beautiful experience playing with Benny Goodman, the sextet.

From there on out, I played with him -- after the show folded at the 'Seven Lively Arts' affair, Benny asked me would I work with him steady, you know, and it was about that time when my engagement at the Three Deuces was about to end anyway. So that's when I joined Benny on a steady basis, you know. That was the start of the happenings with Benny Goodman.
What kind of a person did you see Goodman to be over the years, because you worked with him recently, too.
